true when reading from git; from the worktree, false means the
deploy gate won't see this version until it's committed (manual
runs default to the worktree and will).

effective_runnable.description:
`runnable` with the `evalconf.yaml` fallback resolved — what the
CLI will actually load. Null means the CLI has nothing to run and
the eval will error.

env.description: Env var overrides applied to the eval subprocess (`env` key).

file.description: Repo-relative path of the YAML file this eval lives in.

name.description: Eval name. Required by the CLI — a missing name fails the run.

params.description: Input params passed to the runnable (`params` key), e.g. `prompt`.

runnable.description:
FQN of the runnable under test as written in this entry, e.g.
`../agent.py::agent`. Null when the entry relies on the
`evalconf.yaml` default.

spec.description: The full raw eval entry as parsed YAML (lossless ground truth).

timeout.description: Per-eval timeout in ms, when set.

validators.description:
Flattened assertions (value + flow validators) for display.
The authoritative form stays in `spec`.

EvalJobView.description: Public view of a background eval job.

component_id.description:
Component the job writes evals for — same workforce id accepted as
`component_id` on the other eval routes.

error_message.description: Present when the job terminated unsuccessfully (`failed`, `error`).

output.description:
Kind-specific result payload; `{}` until the job succeeds. For
`generate_initial`: files, eval_count, eval_names, summary,
committed, commit_sha.

EvalRunComponent.description:
The workforce component an eval run targets. Same identifiers the
deployments list exposes on its `target` object: `id` is the workforce
id (accepted as `component_id` filters/body params), `uid` is the
manifest `_id` from `timbal.yaml` (accepted as `component_uid`).
`name`/`type` are display metadata; `uid`/`name`/`type` go NULL if the
app was deleted after the run.

EvalRunDetail.description: One eval run against a workforce component (deploy gate or manual).

commit_hash.description: Git commit SHA the evals executed against.

component.description: The workforce component the evals ran against.

deployment_id.description: The `Deployments` row this run gated. NULL for manual runs.

results.description:
Structured per-eval results (timbal >= 2.2.9): a flat array of
per-eval objects — params/output/usage/validator verdicts/captured
output. On the list endpoint only when `include_results=true`;
NULL for runs that predate structured capture or died before the
report.

status_detail.description: Short human summary, e.g. "1 failed, 2 passed in 12.40s".

EvalRunEvent.description:
One streamed CLI event. `data` is the parsed JSONL line (or a JSON
string if the line wasn't valid JSON — contract violation, kept for
debugging). `seq` is 1-based and monotonic within a run.

done.description:
`true` once the run has finished and all buffered events up to
the terminal one have been returned.

expired.description:
`true` when the run's in-memory buffer is no longer available
(dropped on completion, never existed on this instance, or the
owning process died). Terminal but **possibly incomplete** — do
not treat as a clean end-of-stream; re-fetch
`GET …/evals/runs/{id}` for `status` + the full `results`.

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `after` on the next poll. Equals the last returned seq,
or the request's `after` when the batch is empty.

EvalRunSource.description: Where to read the component source + eval YAML from for a manual run.

ExistingDest.description:
What to do when `dest_table` already holds data — typically because a
one-off job extracted it and the sync is being added afterwards to keep it
fresh.

filesystems.description:
Filesystem root refs configured on the node (names only; the real
paths they map to stay local).

max_depth.description: Deepest directory level seen (the walk root = 0).

total_bytes.description: Sum of regular-file sizes seen (symlinks excluded).

truncated.description: The walk hit a cap — every count is a floor, not a total.

path.description: Root-relative path — feed it back into ls/du/grep or a copy.

extension.description: Lowercased, no dot; extensionless files roll up under `""`.

truncated.description: A cap bit (matches, files, bytes, or time) — `matches` is a prefix.
The entry cap bit — `entries` is a prefix of the real listing.

GrantAttribution.description:
Attribution for a single grant: which role contributed it, what
attachment-level scope was in effect, and the resource pattern as
authored on the role (pre-scope-intersection).

Shared by `POST /iam/check` (matched_allows / matched_denies) and
`GET /iam/users/{id}/effective-grants` (the `via` field on each row).

To derive the effective resource a grant matched against, compute
`resource_pattern_intersect(grant_resource, attachment_scope)`. When
`attachment_scope` is `null`, the effective resource equals
`grant_resource`.

GrantEffect.description: Effect of a [`RoleGrant`]. `deny` wins at eval time.

IceServer.description:
One `RTCIceServer` entry, shaped for direct use in the browser
(`new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers })` / `VoiceSession.start`).

credential.description: TURN credential. Absent on STUN entries.

username.description: TURN username. Absent on STUN entries.

IdentityProviderKind.description:
Which provider implementation drives a connection's login flow. Mirrors the
`kind` CHECK in `db/init.sql`; widened additively as kinds ship (`oidc`
first, `saml` later).

IdentityProviderView.description: Masked view of a connection. Never includes the client secret.

client_id.description: OIDC client id. `null` for non-OIDC kinds.

client_secret_set.description:
Whether a client secret is configured. The secret itself is never
returned.

default_role_id.description:
Catch-all role granted to JIT members with no matching group mapping.
`null` = no catch-all role.

enforced.description: Read-only here: SSO enforcement isn't configurable via the API yet.

issuer.description:
OIDC issuer. `null` for non-OIDC kinds (e.g. SAML), whose connection
details live in kind-specific fields added when those kinds ship.

ImportSipNumberBody.description: Import a SIP identifier, optionally creating the trunk in the same request.

allowed_numbers.description: Callers allowed to dial this trunk. Empty allows any caller.

label.description: Display label (max 50 characters). Used as the trunk name when creating one.

phone_number.description: E.164, SIP extension, or other Request-URI user part.

remote_domains.description: Origin SIP server FQDNs used for TLS certificate validation.

trunk_id.description: Add this identifier to an existing trunk. Omit to create a trunk.

after_uid.description:
Place the new chunk immediately after this `chunk_uid`. Mutually
exclusive with `before_uid`. If neither is set, the chunk is
appended at the end of the file.

before_uid.description:
Place the new chunk immediately before this `chunk_uid`. Mutually
exclusive with `after_uid`.

embed.description:
Text used for vector / full-text indexing. Defaults to `content`
when omitted; provide an explicit value to keep an
indexing-optimized variant distinct from the user-visible text.

InvalidSpecResBody.description: 422 for a spec that doesn't compose or fails the platform checks.

email.description:
Single email address to invite. Legacy shape — prefer `emails`.
Merged with `emails` when both are provided.

emails.description: Email addresses to invite to the organization.

role_id.description:
Role to grant every invitee in this batch, organization-wide. Accepts a
system role or one of the organization's own roles. Omit to invite with
no role — invitees then have an empty `roles` list until a role is
assigned. Project- or environment-scoped grants and per-member role sets
are set through the member role endpoints, not here.

send_email.description: Whether to send an invitation email to each invitee. Defaults to `true`.

invited.description:
Memberships created by this request. Addresses that were already
members are skipped and do not appear here.

InvitedOrgUser.description: A membership created by a batch invite.

email.description: Normalized (trimmed, lowercased) address the invite was issued for.

user_id.description:
Identifier of the invited member. Assigned at invite time, so it can be
used for role assignment before the invitee has signed up.

duration_ms.description: Run duration in ms — to `finished_at`, or to "now" for a live run.

finished_at.description: When the run reached a terminal state; `null` while still active.

kind.description:
`extract` (row batches into a KB table) or `fs_copy` (files into the
KB document store; `rows_emitted` counts landed files).

rows_per_sec.description: Average landed throughput over the run window; `null` until measurable.

started_at.description: When the run first reported progress (excludes time queued).

sync_id.description: Parent sync this run belongs to; `null` for one-off manual dispatches.

blocks.description:
Source-document layout metadata (e.g. bounding boxes, page coords)
when available. `null` for chunks created or edited by the user.

revision.description: Revision token for optimistic concurrency on update and delete.

K2ChunkSummary.description:
List-endpoint payload. Same fields as [`K2Chunk`] except `blocks`,
which is omitted to keep list responses small. Fetch a single chunk
by `uid` to retrieve `blocks`.

columns.description: Columns involved (for PK, UNIQUE, NOT_NULL). Empty for CHECK.

K2DefaultAccess.description: Per-KB default table access, Postgres-RLS style (locked decision #1).

auto_processing_enabled.description: When false, file uploads to this knowledge base are stored as-is and skipped by the automatic parsing, chunking, and embedding pipeline.

backup_enabled.description: Whether daily snapshots and automatic retention cleanup are enabled.

backup_retention_days.description:
Retention in days: null = 7 days, 0 = indefinitely, otherwise 1–3650.
Latest successful snapshots and the current restore snapshot are protected.

backup_schedule_cron.description:
DEPRECATED: never had a cron behind it; superseded by
`backup_window_utc_hour`. Still returned for existing clients; PATCH
ignores it.

backup_window_utc_hour.description:
Preferred UTC start hour (0–23) of this KB's daily backup window; `null` = fleet
default (01:00 UTC). The daily cadence itself is fixed.

default_access.description:
`open` (tables visible unless a restrictive policy cuts them) or
`closed` (every table denied until a permissive policy grants it).
Same source and same endpoint as `governance_mode`.

governance_mode.description:
Query-time governance mode, read from the knowledge base's own policy
document. Toggle via `PUT …/k2/{kb_id}/policies/governance-mode`
(`k2.policies.manage`). Reports `off` for a knowledge base not
resident on this host until its first query.

parse_state.description:
Pipeline state for parsing + embedding.

One of `pending` (pipeline in flight), `success` (canonical chunks committed;
indexing may still be running/retrying), `failed` (latest attempt failed),
`skipped` (parse=false or unsupported format), or `disabled` (KB upload default off).
Use file details' parsing/embedding records for individual attempt outcomes.

signed_url.description:
CloudFront signed URL on the new CDN for private content. Omitted when
signing is unavailable or the object is public.

url.description: **Deprecated:** prefer `signed_url` when present. Kept for old clients.

K2GovernanceModeResponse.description: The KB's governance posture after the update.

break_glass_allowed.description: Whether sessions may bypass the rule via a logged escalation.

oneOf.description:
Per-column transformation map. Null means no masks.
`{"col": {"type":"redact"}}` is the canonical "hide this column".

enabled.description: When false, the rule body is inactive everywhere it is bound.

revision.description: Revision token for optimistic concurrency on update and delete.

row_filter_dsl.description:
Row predicate. `{"const": bool}` (allow / deny every row) or
`{"sql": "<expr>"}` — a whitelisted boolean expression over the
policy's table (`region = 'EU' AND owner_id = user_id()`). Validated
on write against the table's columns; `sql` requires `table_name`.

table_name.description: Target table within the knowledge base. Null applies to every table.

K2PolicyAuditLevel.description: Audit verbosity for matches against this rule.

K2PolicyCombineMode.description: Postgres-RLS-style combination semantic for a policy binding.

audit.description:
Full governance audit: tables referenced, matched policies, rewrite
notes, denied columns.

evaluated_as.description: The mode the verdict below was computed under.

governance_mode.description: The KB's actual posture right now.

parsed.description: Whether the parser ran (a query touching no governed table skips it).

role_ids.description:
The user's role attachments whose scope covers this KB — what policy
assignments matched against.

sql_governed.description: The statement that would execute under `evaluated_as`.

would.description:
`run` (unchanged), `rewrite` (governed SQL would execute), `reject`,
or `skip` (governance off and not overridden).

statements.description: DDL statements (CREATE TABLE, CREATE INDEX, etc.)

expires_at.description:
Earliest age-based cleanup eligibility, not a deletion deadline.
Protected snapshots may remain beyond this date; null means keep forever.

status.description:
pending, running, completed, failed, pruning, or pruned.
A pruning snapshot is no longer restorable; cleanup resumes across runs.

source_backup_id.description:
`null` for a hydration whose snapshot was resolved via the store-side
HEAD pointer with no matching backup row.

kb_id.description: ID of the K2 knowledge base to link to this project

commit_hash.description:
Head commit of that rev. With `source = "worktree"`, uncommitted
file changes are NOT part of this commit — check per-file
`committed` flags.

rev.description: Branch (worktree) or rev (git) the definitions were read from.

source.description: Where definitions were read from: `worktree` or `git`.

roles.description:
Roles available to this organization — system rows first, then
custom rows alphabetically by name.

next_page_token.description: Token to fetch the next page, or null if this is the last page

org_users.description: List of users in the organization

orgs.description:
Organizations the authenticated user is a member of. An invite *is* a
membership: `invite_users` links the invitee's `Users` row (stubbed if
they haven't signed up yet) at invite time, so invited orgs appear here
from the first sign-in. `invited_at` / `invited_by` tell them apart.

sessions.description: List of sessions (envelopes only — items via the single-session GET)

ListWorkforceResBody.description: Workforce components on the git branch given by `rev`. The `url` field is set only when the component has a **running** deployment for that branch.

connections.description:
`connection_ref` → connection object, same shape as the `connections`
map in the connector's `config.json` (e.g. `{ "kind": "postgres",
"dsn": "...", "query": "read" }`). When present, **replaces** the
connector's whole local connections map. Absent = keep local.

filesystems.description:
`filesystem_ref` → filesystem root object, same shape as the
`filesystems` map in `config.json` (e.g. `{ "path": "/srv/exports" }`).
When present, **replaces** the connector's whole local filesystems map.
Absent = keep local.

connections.description: Which maps were included in the push.

dispatched.description:
Always true on a 202 — the connector validates/acks asynchronously
over the channel and restarts to apply; watch the fleet listing for it
to reconnect.

MembershipKind.description:
How a principal belongs to the organization: a regular member of the
workspace, a platform-managed machine identity, or an end-user who
registered through one of the org's deployed apps (project-scoped
access only, hidden from org membership surfaces).

MetricBinOut.description: One aggregated time bucket of a metric series.

MetricCatalogEntry.description: One metric name observed in the window, with the labels seen under it.

definition_ids.description:
Definitions feeding this series, for linking a custom metric to the
config behind it. Empty for system metrics, and for a custom series
whose definition was deleted while its bins age out.

label_count.description:
Distinct labels observed, even when `labels` was truncated. A number
far above the cap means a filter is minting labels from something
unbounded.

labels.description:
Distinct `label` values observed, capped — see `label_count` for the
true total. Empty for metrics that don't use the label dimension.

origin.description: `system` for platform series, `custom` for org-defined ones.

project_id.description: Project scope; omitted when the filter applies to the whole org.

MetricDefinitionSource.description:
Where a definition draws its observations from.

One variant today. It is in the payload from the start so that adding a
second source is an additive change to this enum instead of a new resource
alongside `/metrics/definitions` — the reason the endpoint is named for
metrics rather than for traces.

MetricOrigin.description:
Who defines a metric series.

The distinction the API cares about is editability, not data source: system
series are emitted by the crons and probes and have no configuration to
show, custom ones are backed by a definition the org can change.

ModelAccess.description: Whether the organization may call the model today.

oneOf.description: What blocks it; `null` when allowed.

ModelCatalog.description: Every model the platform routes, for one organization.

auto.description:
What `auto` can route to: the platform default first, then each of the
organization's ACEs.

ModelPolicy.description: An organization policy rule restricting LLM provider or model usage.

model_id.description:
Model targeted by the rule. Omitted when the rule covers the whole
provider.

provider.description:
Model provider slug, e.g. `byteplus`, `openai`. Omitted on the EU
hosting rule that covers every provider.

ModelPolicyEffect.description:
Whether a policy rule allows or denies its target. A model-level rule
beats a provider-level rule; `deny` beats `allow` at the same specificity.

ModelPricing.description: Token prices in USD per million tokens; `null` where unpriced.

ModelRegion.description: Region the organization's LLM calls are processed in.

eligible.description: Whether the organization's plan allows turning EU hosting on.

not_covered.description:
What EU hosting doesn't keep in the EU yet. Show these before an admin
turns it on, and while it's on.

oneOf.description: Region every LLM call is processed in. Omitted when EU hosting is off.

set_at.description: When EU hosting was last turned on or off.

set_by_user_id.description: Who last turned EU hosting on or off.

expect.description:
Any of `route`, `rule` (null = `default_route`), `model`, `tool` (the
forced tool; null = none), `responds` / `instructs` (booleans).

request.description:
Chat-completions body: `messages`, optional `tools` / `metadata`;
`model: "auto-cost"` etc. picks the profile.

billing_suspended.description:
`true` when billing is suspended because a finalized invoice charge
failed and is still unpaid. While suspended, credit-consuming requests
are blocked until the outstanding invoice is paid.

overage_rate_cents_per_1k.description:
Metered-overage rate in cents per 1,000 credits. Self-serve plans return
the fixed tier default; enterprise returns the negotiated rate when
configured; `null` on free or when overage is unavailable.

overage_threshold_usd.description:
Maximum outstanding overage (whole USD dollars) allowed before an
interim invoice is issued. Self-serve plans return the fixed tier
default (1× monthly subscription); enterprise returns the negotiated
value when configured; `null` when no interim threshold applies.

plan_cancel_at.description:
Unix timestamp (seconds) of the scheduled plan cancellation; `null` when
no cancellation is pending.

plan_cancel_at_period_end.description:
`true` between the moment a user schedules a plan cancellation in the
Billing Portal and the final cancellation taking effect.

plan_period.description:
Billing cadence of the active plan: `"month"` or `"year"`. `null` on the
free plan (no active subscription).

plan_renews_at.description:
Unix timestamp (seconds) when the current billing period ends and the
plan renews. `null` on the free plan (no active subscription). When
`plan_cancel_at_period_end` is `true`, the plan ends at this time instead
of renewing.

stale_count.description:
How many of `alarms` are stale, so a caller can alert on the count
without walking the list.

oneOf.description: Echoed when set.

active_users.description:
Users with at least one run or any spend in the window. `null` only
for a page past the end.

total_users.description: Users across all pages. `null` only for a page past the end.

OrgBinSize.description:
`group_by` on the org analytics endpoints: a bin size (`minute`, `hour`,
`day`), or `total` for a single bin spanning the whole range.

OrgCostsBins.description:
Bins grouped per product surface (`by=resource_type`) or per project
(`by=project`).

bins.description: Buckets with data, ascending; empty buckets are omitted.

banner_url.description: URL of the organization's banner image

invited_at.description:
When the authenticated user was invited. Null if they created the
organization or joined without an invite.

oneOf.description: Who invited the authenticated user, if this membership came from an invite.

is_owner.description: Whether the authenticated user owns this organization.

n_projects.description: Number of projects in the organization

photo_url.description: URL of the organization's profile photo

role.description:
Legacy single-role text. Kept for backward compatibility; new
integrations should rely on `roles`.

roles.description:
Distinct, unexpired role attachments, including project-scoped roles.
This catalog is display metadata, not a statement of org-wide access.

OrgUsageBins.description: Bins with one row each, or grouped per project (`by=project`).

id.description:
Unique user identifier. Null only for legacy pending invites created
before invites allocated a user up front; use `pending` to detect
not-yet-registered members.

pending.description:
True when the member was invited but hasn't completed signup yet. Such
members can still have roles assigned ahead of their first login.

photo_url.description: URL of the user's profile photo

role.description:
Legacy single-role text. Kept for backward compatibility; new
integrations should rely on `roles`.

roles.description:
Roles currently attached to this membership. Empty for members with no
role attachments, including users invited without a role.

OutcomeStatus.description: Whether the business outcome of an outbound call is known.

OverageSummary.description:
Customer-facing overage usage summary for the current credits period.

`used_credits = invoiced_credits + pending_credits`. `invoiced_credits` is
the real metered overage billed on finalized invoices this period (see
[`overage_summary`]); `pending_credits` is the headline "extra usage you'll
be billed for" number, and a non-zero `invoiced_credits` means an interim
(threshold-driven) invoice has already billed part of this period.

cap_credits.description:
Org-configured ceiling on overage credits for the period. `null` means
unlimited (or no cap configured); only meaningful when `enabled`.

enabled.description: Whether usage-based overage billing is currently enabled for the org.

invoiced_credits.description: Overage credits already included on a finalized invoice this period.

pending_credits.description: Overage credits accrued this period that have not been invoiced yet.

period_end.description:
End of the current credits period — when pending overage bills if no
interim invoice fires first. `null` when there is no metered window.

period_start.description:
Start of the current credits period. `null` when the org has no metered
billing window (e.g. free plan with no period anchor).

rate_cents_per_1k.description:
Metered overage rate in cents per 1,000 credits. `null` when overage
pricing is unavailable for the plan.

threshold_usd.description:
Outstanding overage value (whole USD) that triggers an interim invoice.
`null` means overage bills only at the end of the period.

used_credits.description: Total overage credits consumed this period (`invoiced` + `pending`).

PacingBody.description: Request mirror of [`Pacing`]. All fields optional; absent == unthrottled.

max_dop.description:
SQL Server only: `OPTION (MAXDOP n)` to cap server-side query
parallelism. `1` pins single-threaded. Ignored by other sources.

max_rows_per_sec.description: Cap on sustained rows/sec across the job. Omit = unlimited.

read_uncommitted.description:
SQL Server only: read with `READ UNCOMMITTED` (no shared locks, never
blocks the source's OLTP; dirty reads OK for snapshots). No-op elsewhere.

PatchAuthSettingsReqBody.description: Body for `PATCH …/auth` — partial update of the app-auth settings.

enabled.description:
Whether the deployed app requires end-user sign-in. Omit to leave
unchanged.

end_user_role_id.description:
Role auto-attached (scoped to this project) to users who sign in
through the deployed app. Omit to leave unchanged; send `null` to
turn end-user provisioning off. Setting a role is escalation-guarded:
the caller must effectively hold the role's grants at this project's
scope.

embed.description:
Text used for vector / full-text indexing. When `content` is
provided and `embed` is omitted, `embed` is auto-set to the new
`content`. Send an explicit value to keep an indexing-optimized
variant distinct from the user-visible text.

page_start.description:
Tri-state: omit to leave unchanged, send `null` to clear, send an
integer to set.

oneOf.description: Omit to leave unchanged; send `null` to clear all masks.

description.description: Omit to leave unchanged; send `null` to clear.

row_filter_dsl.description: Omit to leave unchanged; send `null` to clear the row filter.

table_name.description: Omit to leave unchanged; send `null` to apply to every table.

PatchMeReqBody.description:
Unknown fields are rejected: a misspelled or unsupported field used to be
dropped silently with a 204, hiding client bugs.

access_request_data.description:
Free-form access-request metadata. Merged (shallow) into the existing
stored object server-side.

oneOf.description:
Email preference categories to change; categories left out keep their
value, and `null` changes nothing.

lang.description: Preferred language (ISO 639-1, e.g. `en`). Cannot be set to null.

name.description: Display name. 1–64 characters. Cannot be set to null.

phone.description: Phone number. Pass null to clear.

oneOf.description:
Onboarding "where did you hear about us" answer. `ai` and `other`
require `where_meet_detail` in the same request. Pass null to clear.

where_meet_detail.description:
Free text for `where_meet` (the prompt used for `ai`, the source for
`other`). At most 1024 characters. Pass null to clear.

PhoneNumber.description: A phone number owned by the connected telephony account.

oneOf.description: Set when this org has bound the number to a project agent.

connection_id.description:
Telnyx voice connection the number is attached to. Numbers with the
same connection share one TeXML application.

id.description: Platform identifier for the number (Twilio SID, Telnyx numeric id).

name.description: Human-readable label for the number, when the account has one set.

phone_number.description: The phone number in E.164 format.

status.description: Platform-reported status of the number (e.g. in-use, active).

oneOf.description: Telnyx only: whether the number is ready to bind, or what to fix first.

PhoneNumberBinding.description: Agent currently answering this number, when we've bound it.

workforce.description: Workforce directory slug the inbound webhook points at.

PreviewK2PolicyRequest.description:
Evaluate a statement through the KB's governance for a user, without
running it.

oneOf.description:
Mode to evaluate under. Defaults to `enforce` — "what would happen
if I flipped it" — independent of the KB's current posture.

sql.description: The SQL a user would submit to `POST …/k2/{kb_id}/query`.

user_id.description:
Whose view to compute. Omit for the caller. Any `Users.id`; a user
with no role covering this KB resolves to `role_ids: []`.

PreviewLabelOut.description: What the filter would have recorded for one label.

labels.description:
Per-label aggregates, exactly as they'd land in `Metrics`. More than a
handful of entries here means `label_source: span_name` over a
high-cardinality predicate — every label is another bin per minute.

observations.description: Total matching spans across the sample.

runs_matched.description: Of those, how many produced at least one observation.

runs_sampled.description: Runs with a trace that were actually inspected.

PreviewMetricDefinitionReq.description:
Body for **POST** `/orgs/{org_id}/metrics/definitions/preview`.

The same predicate fields as create, minus everything about persistence.

limit.description: Runs to inspect, newest first. Default 20, max 50.

project_id.description: Sample runs from one project only.

workforce_id.description:
Sample runs from one agent/workflow. Strongly recommended: it makes
the sample representative of what you're filtering, instead of
whatever the org ran most recently.

project_ids.description: Projects that made them; empty for calls outside a project.

PreviewSampleOut.description: One matched span, for eyeballing that the predicate hit what was intended.

PrincipalKind.description:
Whether a principal is a person or a platform-managed machine identity
(for example a project's service credential).

active_users.description:
Users with at least one run or any spend in the window. `null` only
for a page past the end.

total_users.description: Users across all pages. `null` only for a page past the end.

ProjectAuthSettings.description: Full app-auth configuration for a project. Drives the settings UI.

enabled.description:
Master switch: whether the deployed app requires end-user sign-in at all.
When false the app is public and `providers` is moot until it's turned on.

end_user_role_id.description:
Role auto-attached (scoped to this project) to users who sign in
through the deployed app, or null when end-user provisioning is off.

providers.description: Every known sign-in method with its current state, in a stable order.

ProjectChannel.description:
One channel binding as returned on the project payload. Topology only —
credentials are never included here.

configured.description: Whether credentials for this binding are stored platform-side.

enabled.description:
Soft toggle from the UI. Omitted/`true` means the channel is on; `false`
keeps the workforce mapping so it can be re-enabled without reconfiguring.

env_id.description: Project env that answers the number. Omitted otherwise.

phone_number_id.description:
WhatsApp number connected through Embedded Signup: its Graph phone
number id. Omitted for every other binding.

waba_id.description: WhatsApp Business Account of that number. Omitted otherwise.

workforce.description:
Workforce component the channel talks to — always the component's
manifest uid on read.

ProjectComputeAllocation.description: Compute drawn by one project's active deployments.

total.description: Compute drawn by the project across all environments.

projects.description: Projects with spend in the bin, highest credits first.

ProjectCosts.description: One project's spend within a bin.

credits.description: Credits the customer pays (`charged` on the ledger).

project_id.description:
Project the spend is attributed to; `null` for spend with no project
attribution (org-level requests sent without a project).

usd.description:
Dollar spend, excluding credits-only surfaces (composer,
knowledge-base operations, platform voice) which are priced in credits.

auth_enabled.description:
Master sign-in switch for the deployed app: when false the app is public,
when true it requires end-user sign-in via `auth_providers`.

auth_providers.description:
Enabled end-user sign-in methods for the project's deployed app login
screen (for example `email`, `google`, `microsoft`, `github`). Empty when
no sign-in method has been turned on.

channels.description:
Messaging channel topology for the deployed app (provider → workforce).
Empty when no channels are connected. Topology and configuration state
only; credentials are never included.

default_role.description: Project's default role. All organization members will be assigned this role by default for this project

environments.description: Project environments with their latest deployment status

has_ui.description: Whether the project has a UI interface

is_fav.description: Whether the caller has added this project to their favs

is_public_template.description: Whether the project is a public template

knowledge_bases.description: Knowledge bases connected to this project (new KB system only)

repository_url.description: URL of the project's source code repository. When null, the project does not have source code available

role.description:
**Deprecated — will be removed.** Always `"admin"` for backwards-compatible
response shape. Caller permissions are determined by v2 IAM grants, not
this field. Use `/orgs/{org_id}/iam/check` or effective-grants instead.

screenshot_signed_url.description:
CloudFront-signed screenshot URL, minted per response (TTL-bound).
Present only when the banner is a Timbal-hosted screenshot (private
`orgs/{}/projects/{}/screenshots/*` prefix) and signing is configured.

NOTE: screenshots live under a *private* prefix, so this URL is signed
and short-lived. If a banner ever needs to live on a public / cacheable
surface (timbal.ai landing pages, OG/meta image tags, emails — anywhere
the URL is cached or can't be re-minted per request), copy the object to
a public prefix (e.g. `orgs/{org_id}/assets/...`) and serve that
unsigned instead of signing this one.

search_text.description: Text corpus used for semantic similarity matching when recommending templates.

template_description.description: Public-facing description shown when the project is listed as a template.

template_uses.description: Number of times this template has been used

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp in epoch milliseconds

use_platform_iam.description: Whether the project uses the platform's IAM system for access control

components.description: Effective per-component deploy configuration after resolution.

ProjectEnvComponent.description: Effective deploy configuration for one component of an environment.

component.description:
`"api"` or the workforce id as a string. This is the key to use in
`PATCH .../config` `components`.

cpu.description: NULL unless the component deploys to ECS (resources only apply there).

agents.description:
Agent directory names to scaffold under `workforce/`. Omit for an
empty workforce directory.

kb_id.description:
Knowledge base to attach to the project. Provide an existing KB's
id to link it, or omit to auto-create an empty one.

with_ui.description:
Include the default web UI scaffold, independently of whether the
project has agents or workflows.

workflows.description: Workflow directory names to scaffold under `workforce/`.

default_role.description: Project's default role. All organization members will be assigned this role by default for this project

environments.description:
The project's environments with their latest deployment status, as in
`view=full`. Enough for project cards and the "deployed" filter.

is_fav.description: Whether the caller has added this project to their favs

is_public_template.description: Whether the project is a public template

description.description: Short description of what the template provides.

has_ui.description: Whether the template includes a web UI.

id.description: Project id to pass as `project_id` when creating from this template.

search_text.description: Text corpus used for semantic similarity matching when recommending templates.

template_description.description: Public-facing description shown in the template catalog.

template_uses.description: Number of times this template has been instantiated.

ProjectUsage.description: One project's runs within a bin. Same counters as a usage bin.

n_blocked.description:
Runs stopped by a guardrail. Disjoint from the other buckets, so
totals still add up.

n_users.description: Distinct users with a run in the bin.

n_warning.description:
Completed runs where an intermediate step errored. Disjoint from both
`n_success` and `n_error`, so totals still add up.

p50.description:
Duration percentiles in milliseconds. `null` when the bin has no runs
or when the request sets `percentiles=false`.

projects.description: Projects with runs in the bin, most runs first.

ProjectUser.description: One user with effective access to the project.

allowed_actions.description:
Actions this user is effectively allowed on the project, with role
attribution.

membership_kind.description:
How this user belongs to the organization: `member` (staff),
`service` (machine identity), or `end_user` (registered through the
project's deployed app).

project_roles.description:
Role attachments scoped to exactly this project — the slice managed
by PUT/DELETE on this surface. Empty when access comes solely from
org-wide (unscoped or wildcard-scoped) roles.

actions.description: Action keys that were evaluated, in evaluation order.

next_page_token.description: Token to fetch the next page, or null if this is the last page.

users.description:
Users with at least one allowed action on the project. May hold
fewer entries than the page window even when more pages exist.

project_id.description: Project holding the workforce that defines the tool.

rev.description: Branch to read the tool's source from. Defaults to `main`.

tool.description: Name of the custom tool to extract and share.

workforce.description:
Workforce member the tool lives in (id, manifest uuid, or folder
name under `workforce/`).

created.description:
`true` when this publish created the library entry; `false` on a
version bump of an existing tool.

PutAuthProviderReqBody.description: Body for `PUT …/auth/providers/{provider}` — upsert one sign-in method.

enabled.description: Turn the sign-in method on or off.

credentials.description:
Provider secrets, **write-only** (never returned on any read). Omit to
keep the stored credentials for this binding; `null` clears them; an
object replaces them. Telegram: `token` (+ optional `secret_token`).
Slack: `bot_token` + `signing_secret`. WhatsApp (manual, own Meta
app): `access_token`, `phone_number_id`, `app_secret`, `verify_token`;
Timbal's own app secret is refused — use Embedded Signup.

explain.description: When true, runs EXPLAIN ANALYZE and includes the query plan in the response.

params.description: Optional query parameters bound to SQL placeholders ($1, $2, …).

sql.description:
SQL query to execute against the knowledge base.
Use $1, $2, etc. for parameter placeholders.

max_rows.description: Row cap on the returned result. Defaults to 500, ceiling 10000.

mode.description:
`read` (default) | `write`. `read` is enforced node-side with
engine-level read-only semantics; `write` additionally requires the
connection's local policy (`connections.json`) to allow writes.

sql.description:
The SQL to run. One statement on MySQL; multi-statement batches work on
Postgres and SQL Server (the **last** result set is returned; on
Postgres that's the last *row-returning* set — zero-row sets are
invisible to the node's driver — while SQL Server returns the true
last set even when empty).

timeout_ms.description:
Node-side execution budget in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000,
ceiling 60000.

rows.description:
Row-major, aligned with `columns`. Cells are plain JSON scalars:
numbers stay numbers, exact decimals and timestamps are strings,
binary is `0x`-prefixed hex, NULL is `null`.

rows_affected.description:
Rows changed by non-row-returning statements, when the engine reports
it (Postgres/MySQL; `null` on SQL Server = unknown, not zero).

truncated.description: The node's row or byte cap bit — `rows` is a prefix of the real result.

url.description: New channel URL to dial, e.g. `wss://api.timbal.ai/v1/connect/channel`.

dispatched.description:
Always true on a 202 — the connector acks/reverts asynchronously over
the channel; watch the fleet listing for it to reconnect.

RelationalSourceBody.description:
Shared shape for the relational sources (Postgres, SQL Server, MySQL).
`schema` defaults per-source (`public` / `dbo` / the connection DSN's
default database — on MySQL `schema` *is* the database name).

connection_ref.description:
Name of a connection in the connector's local `connections.json`.
The DSN itself never leaves the connector box.

cursor_column.description:
Monotonic column for incremental extraction (`id`, `updated_at`, ...).
Omit for a *snapshot* (full-scan) pass over the whole table, unordered
and with no checkpoint/resume — for tables with no usable cursor
(requires the connector to advertise `extract:snapshot`, 0.1.25+). On a
sync that makes every run a full refresh of the destination.

schema.description: Source schema; defaults to `public` (Postgres) / `dbo` (SQL Server).

email.description:
Email address of the user to remove from the organization. Merged with
`emails` when both are provided.

emails.description:
Email addresses to remove in one request. When non-empty, batch
removal is used and not-found addresses are skipped.

role_ids.description:
Desired set of roles attached to this user at this project's scope.
Roles present today but not listed are detached; new ones are
attached. An empty list removes the user's project-scoped access.
Duplicates are ignored. Attachments the user holds elsewhere
(org-wide or on other projects) are not affected.

attachments.description:
Desired attachment set for this member. Attachments present today
but not in the list are detached; new ones are attached. An empty
list detaches everything. Duplicate `(role_id, scope)` pairs are
ignored.

ttl_secs.description: Token lifetime in seconds. Default 86400 (24h), max 30 days.

token.description: Raw enrollment token, shown once in the response.

ResidencyPreview.description: The organization's last 30 days of LLM usage, replayed against a region.

allowed.description: Models that would keep working, served in the region.

blocked.description: Models that would be refused, most-used first.

region.description: The region to preview; only `eu` today.

actions.description: Action keys that were evaluated, in evaluation order.

next_page_token.description: Token to fetch the next page, or null if this is the last page.

users.description:
Members with at least one allowed action on the resource. May hold
fewer entries than the page window even when more pages exist.

Response.description:
Resolved window echoed back so the client can paginate / refresh
without re-deriving the defaults the server applied.

disconnected.description:
Whether a live channel connection was torn down here. `false` just means
the box was already offline — its credential is dead either way, so a
reconnect is refused.

stopped_syncs.description:
Enabled syncs that were pointing at this connector. They are left in
place but stop dispatching, since picking due syncs skips revoked
connectors. Recreate them against a replacement connector — recreating
against the same `dest_table` adopts the rows already there.

RoleDetail.description: A role with its full grant set.

grants.description: Domain grants this role carries. May be empty.

RoleGrant.description:
A single grant on a role — `(effect, action, resource?, condition?)`.

`resource` is `None` for `ResourceKind::None` actions (`users.read`),
or a hierarchical path like `projects:42:envs:5` (or `projects:42:envs:*`)
for typed actions.

`condition` is opaque JSON reserved for future ABAC; ignored by the
evaluator in v1, accepted and stored as-is by writes.

RoleInUseConflict.description:
Returned when `DELETE /orgs/{org_id}/iam/roles/{role_id}` is called while
the role is still attached to one or more members.

RolePreview.description:
Compact role record returned by listing endpoints. Fetch a single
role to retrieve the full grant set.

name.description:
Role name. Unique per `(org_id)` for custom roles, globally unique
for system roles.

RoleSource.description:
Whether a role is a built-in preset or defined by the organization.
`system` roles are read-only; `custom` roles can be edited or deleted
by an organization admin.

RoutineBudget.description:
Limits on a routine's fires. A slot over `fires_per_day` (rolling 24 h) or
`credits_per_month` (calendar month, UTC) is skipped as `budget`; a fire
that alone costs more than `credits_per_fire` pauses the routine.

RoutineFire.description: One slot of a routine: fired, or skipped with the reason.

reason.description:
Why it was skipped (`missed`, `overlap`, `budget`, `paused`,
`deleted`) or why it failed.

run_id.description: The run it started (the run's idempotency key), chosen before the fire.

created_by_run_id.description: The run that created it, when an agent did.

tool_policy.description:
Always `unsupported` for now: fires run with the agent's full tool
set, because no tool policy can be enforced on a plain run yet.

decider.description:
Decide with one decider alone: `typesafe`, `openai-decisions`,
`baseten`, or `provider/model` (see `POST /aces/test`).

spec.description:
An unsaved spec to run the cases against; else `version`, else the
active version.

cost_credits.description: Credits the customer pays for this run (`charged` on the ledger).

component_id.description:
Workforce component by numeric app id (the `TIMBAL_APP_ID` value;
number or string). At least one of `component_id` / `component_uid`
is required; when both are set, they must resolve to the same
component.

component_uid.description: Workforce component by manifest uid (the `_id` in `timbal.yaml`).

rev.description:
Git rev to extract when `source = "git"` (branch, tag, or SHA).
Defaults to the env's tracked branch. Rejected when
`source = "worktree"`.

source.description:
`worktree` (default) or `git`. Worktree includes uncommitted
evals; git is a clean extract at `rev`.

eval_run_id.description:
Id of the created eval run. Stream `GET .../evals/runs/{eval_run_id}/events`
or poll `GET .../evals/runs/{eval_run_id}`.

cost_credits.description: Credits the customer pays for this run (`charged` on the ledger).

dispatched.description:
`true`: a run left for the connector on this request; `job_id` is set.
`false`: the connector's socket lives on another control-plane instance
(or the box is briefly offline), so the run was queued instead — the
instance holding the socket dispatches it on its next scheduler tick
(~30s), or on reconnect.

job_id.description:
The dispatched run's `ConnectorJobs` id — poll it via the jobs routes.
`null` when the run was queued (`dispatched: false`); the queued run's
job appears at the top of `recent_runs` once it fires.

activate.description: Route with this version right away.

prose.description:
The routing instructions `spec` was compiled from (`POST
/aces/compile`), kept with the version.

require_passing.description: Refuse to save (422 `CASES_FAILED`) when a case fails.

run_cases.description:
Run the ACE's regression cases against the spec first (default true
when it has any).

spec.description:
An overlay on the platform default (`"extends": "default"` with
`questions`, `rules`, `routes`, `primary`, `profiles`, ...; see `GET
/aces/schema`).

oneOf.description: The regression cases run against this version, when it has any.

warnings.description: Non-blocking findings (e.g. an alias without a cross-vendor fallback).

oneOf.description: A cron pattern (5 fields, or a nickname like `@daily`), in an IANA zone.

Every `every_secs` seconds (at least 60), counted from the routine's
creation.
Once, at `at`.

ScimTokenView.description: Masked view of a SCIM token. Never includes the secret.

format.description:
Kind-specific properties (audio: layout, sample_rate, bitrate_kbps,
duration_secs)

url.description:
Time-limited download URL. Refresh an expired one by re-fetching the
session (or `POST /orgs/{org_id}/content/sign`).

usd.description: `None` on credits-only surfaces — which today is every voice surface.

credits.description: Credits the customer pays for this line (`charged`).

usd.description:
Only for `resource_type`s outside `CREDITS_ONLY`. Both voice
surfaces (`voice_session`, `composer`) run on platform provider keys,
so their USD is our cost basis and is never serialized here.

offset_ms.description:
Position on the session timeline (voice: audio offset — drives
highlight-as-audio-plays).

run_id.description: Run behind this item; joins `Traces (org_id, run_id)`.

SessionPreview.description:
Envelope row for list views. Deliberately excludes `meta` / `metrics` /
`summary` — list responses stay lean; the detail view carries the rest.

allOf.description:
Envelope row for list views. Deliberately excludes `meta` / `metrics` /
`summary` — list responses stay lean; the detail view carries the rest.

oneOf.description:
Platform-media voice: what the call cost (STT/TTS/platform lines from
`OrgsCosts`). Absent for sessions that were not metered.

metrics.description: Voice: per-turn latency metrics from the recording manifest

SetDefaultRoleReqBody.description:
Body for the dedicated default-role endpoint. The field is required but may
be `null` to clear the catch-all role (no separate "unset" verb needed).

role_id.description:
Target role id, or `null` to remove the catch-all (group-mapping-only).
Accepts a number or a stringified id.

name.description: When null, the branch will be cleared

SetK2GovernanceModeRequest.description: Set either or both posture fields; an omitted field is left as is.

oneOf.description:
`closed` is an explicit allow-list: with no permissive binding
granting a table, callers get zero rows from it. Flip it only after
`POST …/policies/preview` shows the grants you expect.

confirm_data_leaves_eu.description: Required to turn EU hosting off: LLM calls may then be processed outside the EU.

oneOf.description: `eu` to turn EU hosting on; `null` to turn it off.

SignContentRequest.description: Request to mint a fresh CDN URL for a stored content object.

url.description:
A content URL previously returned by the API (signed or unsigned), or a
bare object key. The server resolves it back to a known object it owns,
re-checks your access, and mints a fresh URL — useful when a cached
signed URL has expired and you want a new one without re-fetching the
whole parent resource.

SignContentResponse.description: A freshly-minted CDN URL pair for a stored content object.

signed_url.description:
CloudFront signed URL for private content. Omitted when the object is
public or signing is unavailable.

url.description:
Legacy unsigned CDN URL. Populated for backwards compatibility; prefer
`signed_url` when present.

SipCallStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a SIP call.

SipCallView.description: A SIP call and where it stands.

oneOf.description: Why the call ended. Absent while it is in progress.

failure_reason.description: Human-readable detail when the call failed.

finalized_at.description:
When the outbound call ended and its outcome settled. From then on the
call and its result no longer change.

oneOf.description: The workflow run that placed the call, as declared when it was created.

outcome.description: The outcome the agent reported, matching the call's `outcome_schema`.

oneOf.description:
Outbound calls only: whether the agent's business outcome is known.
Separate from `status`: a completed call does not imply a successful
outcome.

session_id.description: Voice session holding the call's transcript and recording, when known.

sip_status_code.description: SIP response code from the carrier when a dial failed (e.g. 486).

SipNumberBinding.description: Bound workforce for a SIP identifier.

SipNumberView.description: Flat org SIP identifier (one row per trunk number).

oneOf.description: Agent currently answering this identifier, when bound.

phone_number.description: E.164, SIP extension, or other Request-URI user part.

allowed_numbers.description: Callers allowed to dial this trunk. Empty allows any caller.

numbers.description: Identifiers this trunk serves. E.164, SIP extensions, or other Request-URI user parts.

remote_domains.description: Origin SIP server FQDNs used for TLS certificate validation.

SourceBody.description:
The source half of a dispatch, tagged by `kind`. Each variant maps to a
`SourceSpec` and gates on the connector advertising the matching
`source:<kind>` capability. Request shape:
`"source": { "kind": "sql_server", "connection_ref": "...", "table": "...", "cursor_column": "..." }`.

SourceCost.description:
One cost type's spend within a source group. Unlike [`Cost`], `usd` is
nullable: credits-only surfaces never expose a dollar figure.

credits.description: Credits the customer pays (`charged` on the ledger).

unit.description:
Metered unit (`tokens`, `seconds`, ...) for surfaces with a dollar
price; `credits` for credits-only surfaces.

usd.description:
Dollar spend. `null` for credits-only surfaces (`composer`, `kb_*`),
which are priced in credits.

SourceCosts.description:
Spend for one product surface (`resource_type` on the credit ledger)
within a bin, with the per-cost-type breakdown nested.

credits.description: Credits the customer pays (`charged` on the ledger).

resource_type.description:
Product surface that produced the spend (`app_run`, `composer`,
`kb_query`, `kb_file_parsing`, `kb_file_embedding`, `transcription`,
`ace_run`, `org_api_request`, `project_api_request`, `voice_session`),
or `legacy` for rows recorded before source attribution existed.

usd.description:
Dollar spend. `null` for credits-only surfaces (`composer`, `kb_*`),
which are priced in credits.

SpecIssue.description: One spec error or warning, located in the document that was sent.

path.description:
Dotted location: `rules.<id>`, `questions.<id>`, `routes.<alias>`,
`profiles.<name>.routes.<alias>`, `primary.<alias>`, `extends`,
`disable`, ... Absent when the document itself doesn't parse (the
message says where).

language_behavior.description: auto, english_default, arabic_hint_only, text, or voice_model.

languages.description: Provider-native language codes; not all lists are exhaustive.

voices.description: Named voices supported by the adapter, or reviewed Aura model IDs.

state.description:
Job state after the stop: `stopped` if this call terminalized it, else
the terminal state it already had (idempotent re-stops included).

SyncRunView.description: One historical run of a sync, with derived timing.

SyncStatsView.description: Rollup of a sync's run history (from its `ConnectorJobs`).

consecutive_failures.description:
Failed runs since the last completed one. Non-zero means retries are
backing off (the effective interval doubles per failure, capped at an
hour); at 10 the sync is disabled with `disabled_reason` set.

cursor_column.description:
`null` for a full-refresh sync: it has no checkpoint, so every run
re-reads the source table and rebuilds `dest_table`.

disabled_reason.description:
Why the control plane disabled this sync (auto-disable after consecutive
failures, last error included). `null` when `enabled`, and for operator
pauses. Cleared on re-enable.

has_cursor.description:
Whether the sync holds a resume checkpoint — committed by a landed batch,
or seeded at creation when it adopted an existing destination table. Its
next run resumes rather than rebuilding. The raw cursor is intentionally
not exposed.

key_columns.description: Ordered destination primary-key columns; empty for a keyless table.

last_success_at.description: Last time a run reached `completed`; `null` if it has never succeeded.

seconds_since_success.description:
Freshness/lag: seconds since the last successful run. `null` if never
succeeded. Compare against `interval_secs` to spot a stalling sync.

comment.description: Table description from the source's own doc mechanism.

size_bytes.description: Total on-disk size (data + indexes) in bytes, when the source reports one.

approx_rows.description: Planner estimate; `-1` when the table was never analyzed.

TelephonyPlatform.description: Telephony platform the phone numbers are fetched from.

TempFile.description: Short-lived upload metadata returned by POST /files.

content_length.description: Size of the uploaded payload in bytes.

content_type.description: MIME type as reported by the client.

expires_at.description: When the download URL is expected to stop working (~24h after upload).

name.description: Original filename (sanitized — slashes / control characters replaced).

url.description: Download URL. Anyone with this URL can fetch the file until it expires.

TemplateComponent.description: One workforce component discovered in the template's git tree.

name.description: Directory name under `workforce/` (the name to put in the spec arrays).

TemplateDetail.description:
Full public-template record: catalog metadata plus the git inventory the
clone will actually contain. Used by Composer to write a delta build brief.

agents.description: Agent dir names already in the clone.

workflows.description: Workflow dir names already in the clone.

cases.description:
1-20 chat-completions request bodies (`messages`, optional `tools`
and `metadata`); `model` is ignored.

decider.description:
Decide with one decider alone (no fallback): `typesafe`,
`openai-decisions`, `baseten` (mammoth-1), or `provider/model` for a
specific model (`typesafe/jev-1.13.0`,
`baseten/decision-models/baseten-elephant-9b-latest`). Up to 4,
comma-separated, to run each and report where their routes differ;
`both` = `typesafe,openai-decisions`. Omit for the production chain.

spec.description:
An unsaved overlay. Omit to test a stored ACE, or omit both this and
`ace_uid` to test the platform default.

version.description: Version of `ace_uid` to test; defaults to the active one.

disagreements.description: With several deciders: cases where all answered and the routes differ.

results.description:
One decision per case, in order, shaped like an `AceCalls` decision:
`route`, `model`, `targets`, `rule` (the deciding rule), `applied`
(rules without a route that matched), `adjusted` (`{from, by}` when a
`min` / `max` moved the route), `shadow`, `answers`, `features`,
`skipped_decider`, `decider`, `hedged`, `errors`, `elapsed_ms`, and
with `force_tool`: `forced_tool` / `force_model` when this request's
call would be forced; `responded` (the reply text) when a `respond`
rule would answer it; `instruct` when rules add one.
With several deciders: `{same_route, <decider>: decision, ...}`, one
key per name as sent (`both`: `typesafe`, `openai-decisions`);
`same_route` is null when any decider failed.

Token.description: User credential (API key or future kinds).

hint.description: Masked secret for display (prefix and suffix only).

org_id.description: Organization the credential is scoped to. Omitted for legacy full-access keys.

scope.description: IAM scope path (e.g. `projects:42`). Omitted for legacy full-access keys.

secret.description: Full secret value. Present only in the create response; omitted on list.

manifest.description:
Tool metadata: importable binding, parameters, python requirements,
required integrations and environment variables, and origin.

rev.description: Exact library commit used for `manifest` and `source`.

source.description: The tool's self-contained python module at `rev`.

ToolEntry.title: OrgTool
ToolEntry.description: A tool in the org library.

head_rev.description: Library revision of the latest published version.

name.description: Runtime tool name, unique within the org library.

source_project_id.description:
Project the tool was published from. Republishing is reserved to
this project unless the caller can manage the library.

source_workforce_id.description: Workforce the tool was published from (informational).

UpdateAceBody.description:
Omitted fields are left as they are; an empty string clears `slug` or
`description`.

clear_threshold.description:
Double-option so `null` clears the hysteresis and an absent key leaves
it alone — a plain `Option` can't tell those apart.

components.description:
Per-component overrides, keyed by `"api"` or a workforce id. Each
entry sent REPLACES the stored entry wholesale (it is the source of
truth for that component); `null` removes the entry so the component
falls back to the env/app-level layering. Keys not present in the
map are left untouched.

evals.description:
Deploy-time eval gate (GitHub-Actions-style required check):
`true` arms it for every workforce component in this env — deploys
run the component's committed evals first and fail on a non-pass.
`false` disarms. Omit to leave unchanged. Per-component override
lives on that workforce's own deploy config.

evals_on_push.description:
Push-triggered CI eval runs: `true` runs the eval suite of every
component with eval files on each push to this env's branch —
report-only (`trigger_type = 'push'` on the runs), gates nothing.
Per component, skipped when that component's deploy gate is armed
(env- or app-level `evals`), since the gate already runs those
evals on the push-triggered redeploy. Omit to leave unchanged.

UpdateIdentityProviderReqBody.description:
Update a connection. All fields optional; absent = unchanged. `client_secret`
is write-only — supply it only to rotate.

UpdateMetricDefinitionReq.description:
Body for **PATCH** `/orgs/{org_id}/metrics/definitions/{id}`.

Only the knobs that are safe to change in place. The predicate and the
destination metric are immutable: editing them would splice two different
meanings into one series with no marker at the seam, so a changed
definition should be a new definition.

photo_url.description: Public URL of the newly stored org logo.
Public URL of the newly stored profile picture.

version.description: Target version (`0.1.3` or `v0.1.3`). Omit for the published `latest`.

artifact.description: Release artifact selected for the connector's platform.

dispatched.description: `false` when the connector already reports the target version (no-op).

target_version.description: Bare semver the connector was told to move to.

oneOf.description: Takes effect from now.

UpdateSipNumberBody.description: Update the display label of one SIP identifier.

label.description: Display label (max 50 characters). Empty clears the label.

enabled.description: Pause (`false`) / resume (`true`). Pausing preserves the cursor.

n_blocked.description:
Runs stopped by a guardrail. Disjoint from the other buckets, so
totals still add up.

n_warning.description:
Completed runs where an intermediate step errored. Disjoint from both
`n_success` and `n_error`, so totals still add up.

UsageBy.description: How runs inside each usage bin are grouped.

UserAccess.description:
A principal with effective access, as returned by the reverse-lookup
endpoints (`GET /iam/resources/{resource}/users` and
`GET /iam/actions/{action}/users`).

Only principals with at least one allowed action appear. Deny-beats-allow
is already applied: an action covered by both an allow and a deny grant
is not listed. Platform superadmins are not included unless they also
hold explicit role attachments.

allowed_actions.description:
Actions this principal is effectively allowed to perform, with
attribution.

UserBudgetUsage.description:
One user's personal credit limit and their spend in the current period.
Project budgets apply on top and are not included.

budget_type.description:
Where the limit comes from: `user` (their override), `role` (the
strictest budget among their roles) or `user_default` (the org's
general default). Absent when no personal limit applies.

current_credits.description: Charged credits this period, all pools, after waives.

role_id.description: The role whose budget applies (`budget_type = role`).

UserRolesReq.description: One member's desired attachment set in a bulk request.

attachments.description:
Desired attachment set for this member. Same semantics as the
single-member endpoint: a full replace, an empty list detaches
everything, duplicate `(role_id, scope)` pairs are ignored.

credits.description:
Total credit spend the customer pays across all surfaces (`charged`
on the ledger).

n_blocked.description:
Runs stopped by a guardrail. Disjoint from the other buckets, so
totals still add up.

n_warning.description:
Completed runs where an intermediate step errored. Disjoint from both
`n_success` and `n_error`, so totals still add up.

usd.description:
Dollar spend, excluding credits-only surfaces (composer, knowledge-base
operations) which are priced in credits.

waived_credits.description:
Credits forgiven via on-us discounts (usually 0). Rendered as a muted
"+N on us" annotation so an SA neither vanishes from the table nor
looks like the biggest payer.

voice_config.description: Complete intended speech settings. Omitted fields use native defaults.

ValidatorSummary.description: One assertion extracted from an eval entry, flattened for display.

target.description:
Dot-path of what's being validated, relative to the eval root —
e.g. `output`, `get_datetime.input.timezone`. Empty for
validators attached directly to the root (e.g. a top-level
`seq!`).

value.description: The expected value / steps list, as written in the YAML.

applies_to_all_envs.description:
Whether the variable applies to every environment, including
environments created later.

Voice.description: A voice available for speech synthesis.

description.description: Short description of the voice's tone and suggested use.

id.description: Platform voice identifier. Use this value as the agent's configured voice.

labels.description: Descriptive labels such as accent, gender, or age.

preview_url.description: URL of a short audio sample of the voice.

VoicePlatform.description: Voice platform the catalog is fetched from.

VoiceSetup.description: Whether a Telnyx number can answer an agent with its current voice setup.

expires_at.description:
Expiry, epoch milliseconds. Tickets live 60 seconds — mint right
before connecting, not on page load.

ice_servers.description:
ICE servers for the browser's `RTCPeerConnection`. Platform voice
answers are relay-only, so pass these (STUN + credentialed TURN)
into `VoiceSession.start({ iceServers })` **before** building the
offer — ICE config arriving with the answer is too late. Empty when
the platform has no TURN configured (SDK defaults apply).

ice_transport_policy.description:
`"relay"` when a credentialed TURN entry is present — mirror it as
`iceTransportPolicy` so the browser skips doomed host/srflx pairs.
Absent otherwise.

ticket.description:
Opaque ticket. Present it on the WebSocket connect as `?ticket=…` or
a `timbal.ticket.<ticket>` subprotocol entry. Single use.

WhereMeet.description:
How the user first heard about Timbal. Captured during onboarding and sent
in `PATCH /me` (`where_meet`).

deleted_at.description: Set when the workforce component has been deleted. Only returned from endpoints that include soft-deleted rows (e.g. runs list).

id.description: Identifier of this workforce component within the project.

type.description: Component category (for example agent or workflow).

uid.description: Stable identifier from the project manifest (`timbal.yaml`), when defined.

unversioned_source_updated_at.description:
Newest modification time (epoch millis) of this component's source files in the branch
worktree — what the Composer has written on disk, deployed or not. Lockfiles, caches and
virtualenvs are ignored. Only on the list-workforce response.

url.description: When present, the authenticated Timbal API URL used to call this component’s **running** deployment (for example from the list-workforce response). Omitted where the response does not expose a callable URL, such as on project detail.

voice_recording_enabled.description:
Current platform policy for workforce voice recording, including Studio.
Not a recording-completion receipt: older ECS tasks require redeployment
and customer-hosted media requires its recorder/uploader to be configured.

bearer_auth.description: Timbal API key. Obtain your API key from the Timbal platform settings. See [Authentication](/api-reference/authentication) for more information.
